title: HR22 corrective implementation R1
purpose: Implement the bounded Human Replay JOB22 corrections A-E without changing qualified learning semantics.

A.rootCause: Mobile header and one-course card composition spend too much vertical space; rename management is visually over-weighted.

B.rootCause: progress.isComplete means all authored activities completed, while objective state and recommendation remain separate; UI incorrectly presented this as terminal course mastery and suppressed corrective review when complete.

C.rootCause: Scored feedback always repeated expected answer, including correct responses, and list/arrow formatting can resemble mathematical notation.

D.rootCause: The current V5 course schema and exact showcase expose objectives and activities but no canonical chapter/phase/group hierarchy.

E.rootCause: R15 reservoir focus/click updates the detail but carried no persistent visual/ARIA selected state.

invariants: Scoring authority unchanged; no UI rescoring.
learnit.kit.v5 contract/schema/validator and exact authored showcase unchanged.
V8 selected presenters and mechanics unchanged.
R15 reservoirs remain interactive and retain their canonical state language.
Parent PR #460 remains DRAFT / OPEN / UNMERGED.
Grandparent PR #458 remains DRAFT / OPEN / UNMERGED.
No merge, promotion, GO_LIMITED_PILOT, G5 PASS or student session is authorized.
requiredEvidence: Library with one real course and a representative 12-course scale fixture is compact, scrollable and mobile-safe.
Non-started, validated-recently, ready-for-validation and review-needed objective states are exercised on the exact showcase.
Activity-complete plus ready-for-validation is explained without claiming the course is mastered.
Activity-complete plus review-needed exposes Renforcer maintenant and opens the real review queue.
Correct feedback omits redundant expected answer; incorrect feedback retains learner/expected/explanation context without list bullets or arrow notation.
R15 reservoir focus/touch preserves detail behavior and exposes explicit aria-pressed selected state.
JOB20 provenance, JOB21 R15, JOB22 learner-journey static invariants, V5/V8/showcase/reload/persistence regressions pass.
Build is deterministic and repository governance passes on exact RESULT_SHA.
Immutable HTTPS Human Replay and exact kit are published before the external human decision.
